summary: First testing run of ICE Schedule Ops MVP. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass (auth, tenant isolation, projects, tasks+CPM+lookahead, daily-reports grid pre-population+cascade+submit+PDF stream, RFIs, work-items+links cross-tenant guard, approvals approve/reject, audit log + hash chain growth, schedule import CSV + MPP substitution error + extra='forbid' regression guard via services.schedule_proposal.validate_payload, AI copilot+recovery+rfi-draft via Anthropic, resources, floors+locations, tenant isolation regression). Frontend: login + sidebar (all sections render incl. badge=1) + Audit log (chain valid, 21 entries verified, green badge) + Recovery + Tasks all load. CRITICAL BUG: Approvals and DailyReports pages crash with 'destroy is not a function' React runtime error overlay caused by useEffect(asyncFn) anti-pattern.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(load, [filter]) where load is an async function returns a Promise; React tries to use it as cleanup -> Uncaught TypeError: destroy is not a function. Pre-render error overlay covers entire page.
Same bug: useEffect(load, [activeId]) with async load. Page crashes with 'destroy is not a function'.

action_items: Fix useEffect anti-pattern in /app/frontend/src/pages/Approvals.jsx (line 10) — change useEffect(load, [filter]) to useEffect(() => { load(); }, [filter]).

Fix same useEffect anti-pattern in /app/frontend/src/pages/DailyReports.jsx (line 13) — change useEffect(load, [activeId]) to useEffect(() => { load(); }, [activeId]). DailyReports.jsx:77 already uses the correct pattern, so this is a clear inconsistency.
Optional: scan whole src/ for similar pattern (grep useEffect.*\b[a-z_]+\s*,\s*\[) to ensure no other pages have the same bug.
critical_code_review_comments: useEffect anti-pattern in Approvals.jsx and DailyReports.jsx is a critical React bug — async fn passed directly to useEffect causes runtime crash. Must wrap.

After main agent fixes the 2 useEffect bugs, only the Approvals+DailyReports UI flows need re-testing (open page without runtime overlay; for DailyReports verify 'Open today's report' creates+pre-populates grid, edit cascade, Submit). Use date.today() for daily-report dates because seed activities are anchored to today. The project_id fixture should prefer 'GSA' / 'Federal' projects since /api/projects sort puts newest first.
rca of the issue: Approvals.jsx:10 and DailyReports.jsx:13 pass `load` (an async function) directly as the effect callback: `useEffect(load, [...])`. React invokes the callback and expects the return value to be either undefined or a cleanup function. Async functions implicitly return a Promise, so on next dependency change React tries to call promise.destroy() which throws 'destroy is not a function'. Fix: wrap in a synchronous IIFE: `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [...])` — exactly the pattern already used elsewhere in DailyReports.jsx:77 and on the React docs page the dev-tools warning links to. Reproduction: log in -> click Approvals or Daily reports in sidebar -> red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears.
